scripts.build: bun run build:linux-amd64 && bun run build:linux-arm64
scripts.build:linux-amd64: CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w -X main.version=$(git describe --tags --always)" -o dist/pupitred-linux-amd64 ./cmd/pupitred
scripts.build:linux-arm64: CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm64 go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w -X main.version=$(git describe --tags --always)" -o dist/pupitred-linux-arm64 ./cmd/pupitred
scripts.build:dev: bun run build:dev:linux-amd64 && bun run build:dev:linux-arm64
scripts.build:dev:linux-amd64: CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -tags dev -trimpath -ldflags="-X main.version=$(git describe --tags --always)-dev" -o dist/dev/pupitred-linux-amd64 ./cmd/pupitred
scripts.build:dev:linux-arm64: CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm64 go build -tags dev -trimpath -ldflags="-X main.version=$(git describe --tags --always)-dev" -o dist/dev/pupitred-linux-arm64 ./cmd/pupitred
scripts.release: bun run release:build && bun run release:sign
scripts.release:build: bun run release:linux-amd64 && bun run release:linux-arm64
scripts.release:linux-amd64: CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w -X main.version=${PUPITRE_RELEASE_VERSION:?la version de release est absente} -X pupitre.studio/agent/internal/selfupdate.releasePublicKey=$(go run ./tools/release public-key)" -o dist/release/pupitred-linux-amd64 ./cmd/pupitred
scripts.release:linux-arm64: CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm64 go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w -X main.version=${PUPITRE_RELEASE_VERSION:?la version de release est absente} -X pupitre.studio/agent/internal/selfupdate.releasePublicKey=$(go run ./tools/release public-key)" -o dist/release/pupitred-linux-arm64 ./cmd/pupitred
scripts.release:sign: go run ./tools/release sign --version=${PUPITRE_RELEASE_VERSION:?la version de release est absente} --channel=${PUPITRE_RELEASE_CHANNEL:-beta} --out=dist/release/publications.json --release=dist/release/release.json dist/release/pupitred-linux-amd64 dist/release/pupitred-linux-arm64
scripts.lint: test -z "$(gofmt -l .)" && go vet ./... && go vet -tags dev ./... && { command -v staticcheck >/dev/null && command -v govulncheck >/dev/null || { echo 'staticcheck or govulncheck is missing: bun --cwd=apps/agent run tools:install, with the Go bin folder in your PATH'; exit 1; }; } && staticcheck ./... && staticcheck -tags dev ./... && govulncheck ./...
scripts.tools:install: go install honnef.co/go/tools/cmd/staticcheck@v0.8.1 && go install golang.org/x/vuln/cmd/govulncheck@v1.8.0
